description: Game-screen i18n: localize every in-round game-screen HEADER (audit H1-H12) to use the same localized getters the trail screens use, add the Hebrew path to the Clock Hero generator (audit K1-K8) and the Shape Safari generator + shape names (audit S1-S6) using the Money Math AppLang-threading pattern, and add the deterministic generator + header widget tests. Depends on FEAT-001 (keys and ss.shape.label domain must exist).
steps: Number Quest header + skill tag (plan.md A.1), lib/games/number_quest/screens/game_screen.dart: in _headerTitle remove the isCampaign gate — boss always '${level.boss.emoji} ${context.tr('nq.boss.name', level.bossId, level.boss.name)}', non-boss always context.l10n.levelN(level.number); keep the isDaily->nqDailyHeader branch. For the skill tag, always pass labelOverride = context.tr('nq.skill.label', SkillInfo.fromLabel(_problem.operatorLabel).name, _problem.operatorLabel) into _QuestionCard (drop the mult!=null ternary). SkillInfo already imported.

Shape Safari header (plan.md A.2), lib/games/shape_safari/screens/safari_game_screen.dart: guardian title -> '${widget.level.guardian.emoji} ${context.tr('ss.guardian.name', widget.level.habitat.name, widget.level.guardian.name)}', non-guardian -> '${widget.level.habitat.emoji} ${context.l10n.stopN(widget.level.number)}'.

Shape Safari result banner (plan.md A.3), lib/games/shape_safari/screens/safari_result_screen.dart: resolve the guardian name via context.tr('ss.guardian.name', level.habitat.name, level.guardian.name) before l.safariFriendBanner(...). Import core/l10n/l10n.dart if needed.

Clock Hero header (plan.md A.4), lib/games/clock_hero/screens/clock_game_screen.dart: guardian title -> '${widget.level.guardian.emoji} ${context.tr('ch.guardian.name', widget.level.world.name, widget.level.guardian.name)}', else -> '${widget.level.world.emoji} ${widget.level.isBoss ? context.l10n.guardian : context.l10n.stopN(widget.level.number)}' (confirm the guardian flag name in time_world.dart).

Money Math header (plan.md A.5), lib/games/money_math/screens/money_game_screen.dart: isBoss -> '${widget.level.guardian.emoji} ${context.tr('mm.guardian.name', widget.level.world.name, widget.level.guardian.name)}', else -> '${widget.level.world.emoji} ${context.l10n.stopN(widget.level.number)}'.

Memory Match header (plan.md A.6), lib/games/memory_match/screens/memory_game_screen.dart: read the file to confirm field names, then guardian -> '${guardian.emoji} ${context.tr('mem.guardian.name', world.name, guardian.name)}', else -> '${world.emoji} ${context.l10n.stopN(level.number)}'.

Word Wizard header (plan.md A.7), lib/games/word_wizard/screens/wizard_game_screen.dart: boss -> '${widget.level.boss.emoji} ${context.tr('ww.boss.name', widget.level.chapter.name, widget.level.boss.name)}', non-boss -> '${widget.level.chapter.emoji} ${widget.level.isBoss ? context.l10n.spellMaster : context.l10n.lessonN(widget.level.number)}'. (If FEAT-003 also edits this file for the speaker, coordinate; this FEAT only touches the header line.)

Clock generator Hebrew path (plan.md B.1), lib/games/clock_hero/services/clock_generator.dart: import core/l10n/app_lang.dart and app_strings.dart; add 'final AppLang lang;' with {this.lang = AppLang.en}; forLevel gains {AppLang lang = AppLang.en} and passes it through; resolve 'final s = stringsFor(lang == AppLang.he);'. Replace prompts: _readClock -> s.clockPromptRead; _findClock -> s.clockPromptFind(s.clockSpoken(answer.hour, answer.minute)); _setClock -> s.clockPromptSet(s.clockSpoken(target.hour, target.minute)); _elapsed -> hourWord = s.clockHours(hours); s.clockPromptElapsed(s.clockSpoken(start.hour, start.minute), hourWord). Keep .label numeric choices LTR unchanged.

Clock screen + setter (plan.md B.2, B.3): clock_game_screen.dart add 'late final AppLang _lang;', set _lang = L10n.read(context).lang in initState BEFORE building _questions, pass lang: _lang to forLevel, and pass hourLabel: context.l10n.clockHour / minuteLabel: context.l10n.clockMinute into ClockSetter. clock_setter.dart: add required String hourLabel/minuteLabel params and use them instead of the 'Hour'/'Minute' literals in the two _StepGroup captions.

Shape generator Hebrew path (plan.md C.1), lib/games/shape_safari/services/question_generator.dart: import core/l10n/app_lang.dart, app_strings.dart, localized_catalog.dart; add 'final AppLang lang;' + {this.lang = AppLang.en}; forLevel gains {AppLang lang = AppLang.en}; resolve 's = stringsFor(lang==AppLang.he)'; add helper _shapeLabel(ShapeKind sh) => LocalizedCatalog.resolve('ss.shape.label', sh.name, sh.label, lang: lang). Prompts: _identify->s.ssPromptIdentify, _find->s.ssPromptFind(_shapeLabel(answer)), _countSides->s.ssPromptSides, _pattern->s.ssPromptPattern. _identify answer choices: ShapeChoice.text(_shapeLabel(s)).

Shape screen (plan.md C.2), lib/games/shape_safari/screens/safari_game_screen.dart: add 'late final AppLang _lang;', set in initState, pass lang: _lang to forLevel; in _correctAnswerText localize a shape choice via context.tr('ss.shape.label', c.shape!.name, c.shape!.label) before l.safariWrong(label) (keep text choices as c.text!).

Add test/clock_hero_hebrew_generator_test.dart (plan.md I.1): seeded Random, lang: AppLang.he produces Hebrew prompts (RegExp [\u0590-\u05FF]) and none of the English phrases; lang: AppLang.en reproduces the original English prompts.
Add test/shape_safari_hebrew_generator_test.dart (plan.md I.2): seeded Random, Hebrew prompts + at least one identify question whose text choices contain a Hebrew shape name; English path unchanged.

Add test/game_header_hebrew_test.dart (plan.md I.3): pump a game screen under L10n(lang: AppLang.he, notifier: profile) at 430x900; assert the header shows Hebrew stopN/levelN or Hebrew guardian name and not the raw English, including one boss/guardian case. Mirror the pump scaffolding (SharedPreferences mock, loaded profile+state) from the existing Word Wizard Hebrew test.
Run build web and the full test suite.
acceptance_criteria: In Hebrew mode every game-screen header shows the Hebrew level/stop/guardian/boss title (matching the trail screens), with no raw English 'Stop N'/'Level N'/'Guardian'/'BOSS'/boss name leaking; the Number Quest skill tag shows the localized skill name for all worlds (not just Times Tables).
ClockQuestionGenerator.forLevel(..., lang: AppLang.he) produces Hebrew prompts and Hebrew spoken-time; lang: AppLang.en output is byte-identical to the pre-change English prompts.

ShapeQuestionGenerator.forLevel(..., lang: AppLang.he) produces Hebrew prompts and Hebrew shape names in choices and the wrong-answer feedback; English path unchanged. The Clock setter captions read Hour/Minute in English and שעה/דקה in Hebrew.
The three new tests (clock_hero_hebrew_generator_test, shape_safari_hebrew_generator_test, game_header_hebrew_test) pass; all pre-existing tests stay green.
findings:
All Group A/B/C header + generator edits landed; build web = 'Built build\web'; flutter test = 96 passed (89 baseline + 7 new across 3 files). Notes for FEAT-003:
- HEADERS (A.1-A.7): every game-screen header now uses the trail-screen getters. Number Quest game_screen.dart _headerTitle: dropped the isCampaign gate -> boss always context.tr('nq.boss.name', level.bossId, level.boss.name); non-boss always context.l10n.levelN(level.number); isDaily->nqDailyHeader kept. Skill tag labelOverride is now ALWAYS context.tr('nq.skill.label', SkillInfo.fromLabel(_problem.operatorLabel).name, _problem.operatorLabel) (nullable param kept but always set). Shape/Clock/Money/Memory headers: guardian/boss -> context.tr('<domain>.guardian.name', world/habitat.name, guardian.name); non-boss -> '<emoji> ${context.l10n.stopN(level.number)}'. Word Wizard header: boss -> ww.boss.name via chapter.name; non-boss -> lessonN(number)/spellMaster. Shape result banner (A.3) resolves ss.guardian.name before safariFriendBanner.
- WORD WIZARD HEADER LINE DONE: FEAT-003 should NOT re-touch wizard_game_screen.dart's GameHeader title line; the speaker (_SpeakerButton / _speakWord / _q.spokenWord) is UNTOUCHED here and still present for FEAT-003 to remove.
- GENERATORS: ClockQuestionGenerator and ShapeQuestionGenerator now take {AppLang lang = AppLang.en} on forLevel + a lang field; both resolve `stringsFor(lang==AppLang.he)` and branch prompts (clockPromptRead/Find/Set/Elapsed + clockSpoken + clockHours; ssPromptIdentify/Find/Sides/Pattern). Shape identify choices + wrong-answer feedback localize via LocalizedCatalog.resolve/context.tr('ss.shape.label', shape.name, shape.label). English output verified byte-identical by regression tests. Numeric islands (clock .label, choice numbers) left LTR/unchanged.
- SCREENS resolve _lang = L10n.read(context).lang in initState BEFORE building questions (clock_game_screen.dart, safari_game_screen.dart), matching Money Math/Word Wizard. Clock setter (clock_setter.dart) gained required hourLabel/minuteLabel (clockHour/clockMinute) replacing the 'Hour'/'Minute' literals.
- Memory game_screen.dart newly imports core/l10n/l10n.dart for context.tr/context.l10n (was not localized before).
- Model getters (level.title/boss.name/guardian.name/ShapeKind.label/ClockTime.spoken/SkillInfo.label) left intact as English fallbacks per plan; ClockTime.spoken is now dormant (generator uses clockSpoken).
- Tests: test/clock_hero_hebrew_generator_test.dart, test/shape_safari_hebrew_generator_test.dart, test/game_header_hebrew_test.dart (all deterministic, seeded Random; header test pumps ClockGameScreen under L10n(he) at 430x900 mirroring the Word Wizard Hebrew test). flutter analyze NOT run (Hebrew-path crash) per policy.
